title: Graph Theory, Sixth Edition
citation: Diestel, Reinhard. Graph Theory. 6th ed., Graduate Texts in Mathematics 173, Springer, 2025.
coverage_scope: Core finite-graph objects and methods: adjacency, paths, connectivity, trees, matching, planarity, coloring, flows, and advanced interfaces.
coverage_gaps: The source is a disciplinary text rather than an educational dependency study.
This first corridor does not yet decompose matching, planarity, coloring, flow, extremal, random, or infinite graph theory.
notes: Used for coverage auditing and terminology, not as an imported sequence or source of copied prose.

title: Book of Proof, Third Edition
citation: Hammack, Richard. Book of Proof. 3rd ed., 2018.
coverage_scope: Introductory proof terrain: sets, symbolic logic, direct proof, contrapositive, contradiction, induction, relations, functions, and cardinality.
coverage_gaps: Coverage is introductory and does not exhaust formal proof theory, automated proving, category-theoretic proof, or field-specific proof methods.
The source is a proof text rather than empirical evidence about learning dependencies.
notes: Used for coverage auditing and terminology, not as an imported sequence or source of copied prose.

title: Pre-K–12 GAISE II Report
citation: Bargagliotti, Anna E., et al. Pre-K–12 Guidelines for Assessment and Instruction in Statistics Education II: A Framework for Statistics and Data Science Education. American Statistical Association, 2020.
coverage_scope: Statistical problem-solving process: formulating questions, considering data, analyzing data, and interpreting results with variability throughout.
coverage_gaps: The report is an education framework rather than exhaustive mathematical statistics coverage.
Advanced likelihood, Bayesian, causal, multivariate, and stochastic-process models remain outside this first corridor.
notes: Used for coverage auditing and terminology, not as an imported sequence or source of copied prose.

title: NIST/SEMATECH Engineering Statistics Handbook
citation: NIST and SEMATECH. NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods. National Institute of Standards and Technology.
coverage_scope: Scientific and engineering model-building coverage including exploratory analysis, process modeling, fitting, assumptions, diagnostics, comparison, and interpretation.
coverage_gaps: The handbook emphasizes engineering applications and classical methods.
Its software workflow and chapter order are not imported as canonical dependencies.
notes: Used for coverage auditing and terminology, not as an imported sequence or source of copied prose.
